# Workflow and configuration schemas

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @pair/workflows schema:reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

These schemas come from the workflow validator.

```json
{
  "workflow": {
    "type": "object",
    "required": [
      "version",
      "name",
      "steps"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "version": {
        "const": 1,
        "description": "The grammar version."
      },
      "name": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Equals the file name without its extension."
      },
      "select": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "filter": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "has": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              },
              "lacks": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              },
              "status": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "enum": [
                    "Draft",
                    "Ready",
                    "In Progress",
                    "Review",
                    "Done"
                  ]
                }
              },
              "assignee": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            }
          },
          "order": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "enum": [
                "priority",
                "number",
                "created",
                "status"
              ]
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "description": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "outputs": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "from"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "from": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
          }
        }
      },
      "aliases": {
        "type": "object",
        "propertyNames": {
          "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
        },
        "additionalProperties": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "engine": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "model": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "effort": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        },
        "description": "The aliases the steps cite, each with its default engine, model and effort."
      },
      "assign": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*(?:\\[bot\\])?$",
        "description": "Use `me` for the runner, a login, `none` to keep the assignee, or `unassign` to clear it."
      },
      "steps": {
        "type": "object",
        "minProperties": 1,
        "propertyNames": {
          "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
        },
        "additionalProperties": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "kind"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "enum": [
                "implement",
                "review",
                "fix",
                "generic",
                "gate",
                "approval",
                "merge",
                "refine-story",
                "plan-tasks",
                "loop"
              ],
              "description": "What the step does and what it returns."
            },
            "skill": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:._-]*$",
              "description": "The skill that runs. Optional for a typed kind, required for `generic`."
            },
            "args": {
              "type": "object",
              "propertyNames": {
                "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$"
              },
              "additionalProperties": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "description": "Text arguments passed to the skill."
            },
            "interactive": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "description": "Run this step in the session conversation. Headless runs park when they reach it. Defaults to the kind contract. Set it on loop children and included steps."
            },
            "context": {
              "enum": [
                "fresh",
                "handoff",
                "resume"
              ],
              "description": "How the step receives context from its predecessor. Defaults to the kind contract."
            },
            "prompt": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Literal instructions for the step, up to 300 words."
            },
            "prompt-at": {
              "enum": [
                "before",
                "with",
                "after"
              ],
              "description": "Placement of the prompt relative to the skill invocation. Defaults to `after`."
            },
            "when": {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "minProperties": 1,
              "properties": {
                "has": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  }
                },
                "lacks": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  }
                },
                "status": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  }
                },
                "assignee": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  }
                },
                "output": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$"
                },
                "is": {
                  "type": "array"
                }
              },
              "description": "Runs the step only when the card matches (`has`, `lacks`, `status`, `assignee`; AND between keys, any-of inside a list), or when `output` of an earlier step is one of `is`. Else the step is `skipped`."
            },
            "uses": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "An included workflow whose steps replace this entry."
            },
            "with": {
              "type": "object",
              "description": "Options of the step; the kind declares the keys."
            },
            "gates": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "description": "Optional validation the host runs after the step ends `ok`: a registry key, `target:<name>` or `command:<shell line>`. A red one fails the step. Absent = none."
            },
            "timeout-minutes": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 35791,
              "description": "Agent process timeout in minutes. Absent = the run timeout."
            },
            "retries": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 9007199254740991,
              "description": "Additional attempts after an agent process fault. Absent = 0."
            },
            "on-failed": {
              "enum": [
                "stop",
                "continue"
              ],
              "description": "Shorthand for `escalate.failed`. `stop` (default) stops the run; `continue` records the failure and runs the next step."
            },
            "escalate": {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "properties": {
                "failed": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "enum": [
                        "stop",
                        "continue"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "object",
                      "required": [
                        "do",
                        "comment"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "do": {
                          "enum": [
                            "stop",
                            "continue"
                          ]
                        },
                        "comment": {
                          "type": "string"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "blocked": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "enum": [
                        "stop",
                        "continue"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "object",
                      "required": [
                        "do",
                        "comment"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "do": {
                          "enum": [
                            "stop",
                            "continue"
                          ]
                        },
                        "comment": {
                          "type": "string"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "needs-decision": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "enum": [
                        "stop",
                        "continue"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "object",
                      "required": [
                        "do",
                        "comment"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "do": {
                          "enum": [
                            "stop",
                            "continue"
                          ]
                        },
                        "comment": {
                          "type": "string"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "exhausted": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "enum": [
                        "stop",
                        "continue"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "object",
                      "required": [
                        "do",
                        "comment"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "do": {
                          "enum": [
                            "stop",
                            "continue"
                          ]
                        },
                        "comment": {
                          "type": "string"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                }
              },
              "description": "Rules for non-success statuses. `failed` uses `on-failed` or stops by default; `blocked` and `needs-decision` stop by default. A loop accepts only `exhausted` and uses `on-max` when the rule is absent."
            },
            "on-resume": {
              "type": "object",
              "required": [
                "reason",
                "step"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "properties": {
                "reason": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "\\S"
                },
                "step": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
                }
              },
              "description": "On resume after this step failed with the given reason, refresh the linked PR head and replay from the named earlier step."
            },
            "alias": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "The alias, declared in `aliases`, the step runs with."
            },
            "state": {
              "enum": [
                "Draft",
                "Ready",
                "In Progress",
                "Review",
                "Done",
                "none"
              ],
              "description": "The card's board state the host sets for the step (a macrostate), or `none`; overrides the kind's default."
            },
            "assign": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*(?:\\[bot\\])?$",
              "description": "Use `me` for the runner, a login, `none` to keep the assignee, or `unassign` to clear it."
            },
            "until": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
            },
            "max": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "on-max": {
              "enum": [
                "escalate",
                "fail"
              ],
              "description": "Legacy loop exhaustion rule. `escalate` parks the run, like `escalate.exhausted: stop`. `fail` fails the run and must stand alone. Supply this key or `escalate.exhausted`."
            },
            "steps": {
              "type": "object",
              "minProperties": 1,
              "propertyNames": {
                "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
              },
              "additionalProperties": {}
            }
          }
        },
        "description": "The steps, by id."
      }
    }
  },
```
